## Build GUI binding using Gradle

If you are using Android Studio, you can build the GUI binding using Gradle.

```sh
./gradlew android
```

## Build GUI binding using CMake

If you are using CMake, you can build the GUI binding using CMake.

```sh
cmake -B build -DLLAMA_ANDROID=ON
cmake --build build
```

## Build GUI binding using Make

If you are using Make, you can build the GUI binding using Make.

```sh
make android
```

## Build GUI binding using Docker

If you are using Docker, you can build the GUI binding using Docker.

```sh
docker build -t llama-android .
```

## Build GUI binding using Docker with GPU

If you are using Docker, you can build the GUI binding using Docker with GPU.

```sh
docker build -t llama-android-gpu .
```

## Build GUI binding using Docker with GPU and ARM

If you are using Docker, you can build the GUI binding using Docker with GPU and ARM.

```sh
docker build -t llama-android-gpu-arm .
```
